title: LLV-G125P256: a fixed-precision source budget tightens the lower time term

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single LLV-G125P256 algorithm/configuration of proof.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch including failures, retries, discarded copies and cap aborts, charged sequential work is O(2^((1/8)sqrt n*log2 n+(65/128)sqrt n)). The exact uniform envelope has growth index1/2 and an absolute outside constant. The finite branch n<2^4096 is explicit. Otherwise v=floor(sqrt n),r=ceil(sqrt n),ell=ceil(log2 n),a=ceil(n^(1/8)),B_src=floor(v/2)-a-100ell,H=ceil(log2(a^256)),m=floor(256B_src/H),kappa=ceil(log2(m+a))+3,lambda=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*(a-1))). The exact full-width and binary-finishing algorithm, all hard counters and all-modulus decoders are specified in proof.md. Every variable arity factor, source/extraction, circuit generation, addressing, reset, measurement, discarded work and abort cleanup is charged. The strict 1/256 coefficient gap in Section14 absorbs the proved o(sqrt n) work term, jointly with all other claims. The new fiber list is found by explicitly generated Grover searches on fresh ancillas with charged serial table lookups and list exclusion. A fixed worst-case bound of at mostCp+1 calls and8J maximum-scale trials per call, with a uniform missed-solution allowance, establishes the same merge-failure budget on every branch; the original phase indices are not used as search ancillas.

For the same LLV-G125P256 algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak classical workspace on EVERY branch is O(2^((251/1000)n^(3/8)log2 n)) bits, with an absolute outside constant. The exact uniform envelope has growth index3/8. Retained full-label tables, residue arrays, bounded quantum-found tuple lists with a index fields, search schedules, counters, caps, extraction scratch and streamed decoder records are included. The exact capacity rule gives lambda asymptotic to(1/4)n^(3/8)log2 n, leaving positive coefficient slack to absorb all fixed polynomial storage factors. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8 and all other claims.

For the same LLV-G125P256 algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak quantum allocation on EVERY branch is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant, including all retained phase inputs, variable-arity siblings, finishing levels, fresh U=a*lambda search registers, reusable oracle and reflection scratch, rank/projection registers, source transforms and extraction ancillas. Each search trial resets/releases its ancillas before the next trial. The exact uniform envelope n has growth index0, jointly with success at least1-2^-8 and all other resource/error claims.

For the same LLV-G125P256 algorithm/configuration and every N,s, all fresh source copies acquired on EVERY branch, including rejected, failed, discarded and aborted copies, number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)) with an absolute outside constant. The literal main hard cap nCcap+K is at most2^((1/2)sqrt n) by the exact integer depth budget m*H<=256B_src, with Dbar=2^a K lambda a^m,Dcap=2^12 nDbar,Ccap=2^13 nDbar. The exact envelope has growth index1/2, jointly with full-secret success and all other resource and error claims.

For the same LLV-G125P256 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
